name: neobrutalism-cards
title: Cards
description: Neobrutalism-style card components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and distinct layouts. Great for displaying content, products, and features with a unique, high-contrast retro style.
useWhen: Grouping related content, a feature, or a product in a bold bordered panel.
Using hard shadows and typography to establish an intentionally retro visual hierarchy.
avoidWhen: The visual style must blend into a restrained or neutral design system.
responsiveBehavior: Cards expand to their container on small screens and internal media stacks above content when necessary. Hard shadows do not cause horizontal overflow.
accessibility: Use headings to identify card content and avoid making a whole card clickable when it contains other controls.
Maintain text contrast against saturated card backgrounds.
